title: Wallet SDK signs with the secret key and sends only signatures and public keys over RPC
intent: Distilled from Solana and EVM wallet SDK shapes (@solana/web3.js Keypair and Connection, ethers Wallet): the same module holds keypair.secretKey and a privateKey parameter, signs with nacl.sign.detached and wallet.signTransaction, and posts JSON-RPC bodies carrying the signature, the base58 public key, the wallet address and a transaction receipt. Key material and the network share every release of these files, so code.key-material-exfiltration must stay quiet: signing, public-key and address reads, and transaction methods end the flow. The module is unchanged in this patch, so the release rolls up low.
